# Siam Supply Co.

> Singapore trade importer and wholesaler of Thai household remedies. We buy
> direct from the manufacturer in Hat Yai and supply Singapore trade buyers by
> the carton. Trading name of Jiratham Pte. Ltd., UEN 202433113G.

## What we sell

25 SKUs across 8 brand lines, all imported from Thailand:

- **Hong Thai** compound herb inhaler, 4 formulas (green F1 25 g, green F2 40 g, yellow 25 g, white 25 g). Minimum 600 pcs.
- **Poy-Sian** Mark II two-in-one nasal inhaler. Minimum 120 pcs.
- **Pim Saen** balm, 3 formats (roll-on, liquid oil, cotton-wick inhaler). Minimum 144 pcs.
- **Siang Pure** oils and balms, 7 SKUs (metal ball tips, 3 cc oils, 12 g balms, Formula 2 inhaler). Minimum 144 pcs, or 120 pcs for the inhaler.
- **Pastel X8** pocket inhaler, solid and translucent barrels. Minimum 120 pcs.
- **Happy Noz** onion-based nasal sticker patches for children, 6 variants, box of 6. Minimum 200 boxes.
- **Namman Muay** Thai boxing liniment 15 cc. Minimum 144 pcs.
- **Gumgig Pean** herbal throat lozenges. Minimum 144 pcs.

## How we trade

- **Trade only.** We sell by the carton to businesses, not to consumers.
- **Who buys from us:** provision shops, pharmacies and TCM halls; community
  clubs and welfare groups; corporate and HR buyers; event organisers and resellers.
- **Lead time:** about 5 working days for lines we hold in stock, up to 4 weeks
  for anything brought in on the next purchase order from Hat Yai. We confirm
  which applies when we quote.
- **Pricing:** quoted per piece in Singapore dollars, landed and delivered, with
  no separate freight line. Prices are given on enquiry rather than published.
- **Payment:** on delivery as standard. Net 30 available to community clubs,
  schools and corporate buyers on request.
- **Delivery:** doorstep, anywhere in Singapore.
- **Goods:** supplied as manufactured and packed in Thailand, with the original
  Thai FDA registrations and manufacturer labelling intact.
